Appearance- 6'7 (175 cm) tall, white skinned, Jennifer has a fit and athletic build, is a confident and accomplished woman with a professional demeanor. She stands at around  and her long, brunette hair frames a confident and professional face. Jennifer's eyes are typically an engaging shade of brown, reflecting both intelligence and determination. She carries herself with a mix of grace and strength, befitting her dual roles as a lawyer and a superhero.

Abilities- Turns into She-Hulk. When she transforms into She-Hulk, she gains superhuman strength, durability, and a rapid healing factor. Unlike the Hulk, Jennifer retains her intelligence and personality even in her powerful, green muscular form. Additionally, she possesses resistance against mind control and telepathic attacks. However just LIKE the Hulk, her Green Muscular gets larger and more aggressive the more she’s angered.
Appearance in She-Hulk Form: When transformed into She-Hulk, Jennifer undergoes a remarkable physical metamorphosis. Her already athletic build becomes more pronounced and muscular, and she gains a statuesque and powerful presence, growing powerful thick and toned muscles, her hands becoming colossal. Standing at approximately 7'0ft tall, she exudes confidence, strength, and a very commanding presence. The most noticeable change is her vibrant, emerald-green skin, which complements her bright green eyes.

Jennifer is also Charismatic, able to attract anyone due to her caring, empathy, and humor. She’s very empathetic to her clients as a lawyer and as a hero empathetic to those hurt by villains. She can be very protective and possessive over her lover, Spiderman.
